serum bactericidal assay.readouts: MenA- and MenC-specific bactericidal antibody titres

evidence_location.quote: The first dose of either MenACWY-CRM or MenACWY-PS elicited a rise in SBA geometric mean titres (GMTs) against MenA and MenC 28 days post-vaccination for all groups.

ELISpot.readouts: MenA-, MenC-, and diphtheria toxoid-specific antibody-secreting cell frequencies; memory B-cell-derived ASCs after culture and ex vivo ASCs

evidence_location.quote: MenA- and MenC-specific ex vivo ASCs were detectable 7 days after each vaccine, with inferior MenC-specific ex vivo ASCs seen after the second dose of vaccine in those who previously received MenACWY-PS (Fig. 1c).

aliases: flow cytometric characterisation of B cells and plasma cells
flow cytometry.sample_type: purified CD19+ B cells from PBMCs
flow cytometry.readouts: frequencies of total plasma cells, CXCR3/HLA-DR plasma cell subsets, IgM memory B cells, and switched memory B cells

evidence_location.quote: An expansion of the CXCR3 + HLA-DR + subset 7 days post-immunisation with either MenACWY-CRM or MenACWY-PS was observed (Fig. 2e).

microarray.sample_type: whole blood collected in PAXgene RNA tubes
microarray.readouts: whole-blood transcript expression levels and differential gene expression signatures

evidence_location.quote: In this combined analysis, five transcripts were differentially expressed, three of which were annotated as antibody segments: LOC651751 (Ig kappa chain V-II region), LOC642113 (IGKV3D-20) and LOC649923 (Additional file 3 : Table S2).

quantitative PCR.sample_type: whole-blood RNA from PAXgene tubes converted to cDNA
quantitative PCR.readouts: spliced and unspliced XBP1 isoform expression

evidence_location.quote: To address this query, we conducted quantitative PCR using primers specific for the spliced and unspliced isoforms of XBP1 , finding upregulation of XBP1s but not XBP1u 7 days after an initial dose of either MenACWY-CRM or MenACWY-PS vaccine.
